notes.title: Popcorn: Beta Branch + Twitch
notes.notes:
Hello all,

I've created a beta branch for testing new features with the community! For this first beta, players are now able to authenticate through Twitch, and have their chatters spawn as popcorn kernels.

Once authenticated, players can open up a level and have their chatters opt in by typing "!pop" in the chat. This will add them to the spawn pool, where they have a chance of spawning as a kernel that matches their Twitch chat color with a name tag. A small indicator in the corner will tell you how many chatters are in the spawn pool. They can also leave the spawn pool by typing "!leave".

Currently nothing special happens when they're popped (or turn into a golden popcorn), but I'm working on some ideas. If you have any ideas for fun Twitch features, please share them with me in the comments / the discussions!

You can opt into the beta branch by right clicking on the game title in your Steam library, clicking "Properties..." and going to the Beta tab. If you run into any issues, please let me know if the discussions.

Happy popping!

notes.title: Looking Ahead
notes.notes:
Looking ahead, there are a number of new gameplay features I would like to implement.

[h2]Career Mode[/h2]
Popcorn is currently a very simple clicker game, with most of the gameplay experience coming from chaining together orb explosions to pop large volumes of popcorn and rack up lifetime popcorn eaten for achievements.

In this mode, you would start out with a single spawner and no abilities. As you pop popcorn and earn currency, you would be able to purchase more spawners, abilities, and upgrades. This would hopefully add more of the type of gameplay some would expect from this genre.

[h2]Twitch Integration[/h2]
I'd like to add some kind of fun features for Twitch, like having a chance that your Twitch viewers get spawned as a kernel... and then eaten. 

I feel that this game could be very well suited for the "Just Chatting" type of crowd, and a fun way to engage your chat.

[h2]Known Issues & Bug Fixes[/h2]
There is a known bug where when launching the game, the menu will not appear. This may be fixed by restarting the game or restarting Steam. If you experience this, please let me know in the Discussions in the Bug & Issue reporting section.

Thanks all.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

This update makes the default Steam Deck settings fully compatible by allowing tapping and dragging with the touch screen and emulated mouse buttons (right trigger, left trigger, touchpad press). You'll now be able to expertly place your orbs to maximize your return on explosion and keep your orb chain going.

The desktop version will still require middle mouse input to click and drag objects. Should the dragging with left click also be an option for the desktop? Let me know what you think.

notes.title: Popcorn! Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Popcorn! is currently [b]mostly[/b] supported on the Steam Deck, utilizing the default settings. The only thing not supported by default is the middle mouse click and drag functionality. The middle mouse can be mapped, but I want to add a platform specific function to click and drag using the touch screen for Steam Deck.

The touch screen is seemingly the best way to play, but you can use the touch pad cursor along with the trigger buttons to click.


Thanks!
